posts.name: broccoli
posts.cooked:
Just got the unlock using some information I'd seen on the Steam forums.

The pieces were:

Tachyon, Absolute Zero, Wraith, Ra, and Omnitron-X vs. Baron Blade in Time Cataclysm

I was also trying for TL Tachyon, so I got everyone to <10.  Based on what I saw in the Steam forums, I got every piece of Absolute Zero's equipment out, but made sure he had 0 at the end (thanks to Singularity).  I also got out Glacial Structure, but it was also not out at the end.  I never did get Cold Snap or Impale out though, so "all ongoings" shouldn't be a requirement.  I won with Tachyon doing FoFx3 and a Lightspeed Barrage, but AZ and every one were alive.  My guess is:

Lose with AZ to Iron Legacy (seems to be a common theme with F6).

Win a game in which AZ is <10 and plays all equipment cards, but none are in play at the end, which at least 1 ST hero on the team.

(For those curious, I did NOT get TL Tachyon).

posts.name: MigrantP
posts.cooked:
On the right track, and finally pinned down over on Steam. Thanks to the investigative work here and on the Steam forums, the unlock conditions for Freedom Six Absolute Zero have been determined by the community. Well done everyone!
 
Lose a game to Iron Legacy with regular Absolute Zero on the team. Then, defeat any villain with regular Absolute Zero and without a Legacy on the team. Each of Absolute Zero’s equipment cards must be destroyed at least once, and he may not be incapacitated.

posts.cooked:
Bunston:

 

Jimeni wrote:
Yes. All four both times. EDIT: The first time I had all four in play when Villain Omnitron hit us with a destroy all equipment. In the other game,  I had destroyed cryo chamber with its power, and then had Omniton X do a sigularity on the other 3 pieces of equipment. And with each of these games, I'd previously lost to Iron Legacy with him on the team, so I should have two losses (at least) of that in the history.  
Was Legacy on your team?

Nope. My team in both games was Team Leader Tachyon (to help AZ get his equipment out), Omnitron X so I could use Singularity to destroy all AZ's equipment in one move if needed, Absolute Zero (of course) … And Ra and Haka to round it out with more heavy hitting.  In my first game, AZ ended with a piece of equipment out (after all 4 were destroyed, I put one out 'cause the wording didn't say you couldn't have equipment out at the end). But in the second game, he didn't have any equipment out at the end. He had nothing out, though until the final turn he had impale out. After Omnitron was impaled to death, Omnitron and Impale were destroyed. Then AZ killed the last drone in his play phase, winning the game and dealing the final blow to both Omnitron and his last drone. In the first game, I think it was O-X who dealt the final blow, though, in that game I'm pretty sure a drone (rather than Omnitron himself) was also the last one standing. Wouldn't think that would matter, but it was something to think about … In both games that didn't unlock, the game didn't end immediately when the villain was destroyed. We were, however, victorious both times and AZ survived both times … In the second game, he was nearly at full health (25, I think). In the first game, I think he was around 10 hp.

 

Oh well. Will try again (Oh no, I have to play more Sentinels, what a travesty!), but some wonkiness is going on.

UPDATE: After these two attempts failed, I decided to do something a little different and challenge myself by trying to unlock Absolute Zero and Unity in the same game. And it worked! It was a fun game where Unity, who was just refusing to lose any hp most of the game, found her bot army – and Ra – turning against her! Stealth Bot would redirect damage from negative energy field for everyone else but her. And, alas, I got both of them unlocked, so now I have half of the Freedom 6. (I avoided Omniton in this attempt … Went up against Baron Blade instead.)
